text.p: Interactive Buyers Network International Ltd said Tuesday its shareholders have approved its restructuring including the issuance of about 2.9 million common shares.
The shares will be issued to the individuals comprising the Thomure Group and will take outstanding Interactive Buyers Network International common shares to about 5.9 million.

After the December 2 shareholders meeting Joseph Thomure was elected chief executive officer, Samuel Bradt was elected chief financial officer and treasurer and Michael Hastings was re-elected president.

The company also said that at its December board meeting directors approved a plan to privately raise up to $1.2 million in two phases. The first phase is expected to net between $400,000 and $700,000, and is now in process.
